name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Zelensky Says Ukraine Will Resume Russian Refinery Strikes, Defying Trump
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed overt frustration with the United States in an interview with The Financial Times. He had paused the strikes to comply with a demand from the United States.

changes.title: U.S. sending hundreds of troops to Latin America for training, New York Times reports
changes.summary: The U.S. will send several hundred Army soldiers to train and conduct exercises with Latin American military forces, The New York Times reports. Officials said it is part of an effort to fight drug trafficking in the region. Eric Schmitt, senior national security correspondent for The New York Times, joins CBS News to.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Just a after hitting fresh all-time highs, U.S. stocks are under strain as investors worry about returns on the trillions of dollars that have been put into AI.

changes.title: Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation
changes.summary: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance. (Image credit: Mario Tama).

changes.title: Ukraine less reliant on U.S. as Trump-Zelenskyy rift deepens, former ambassador says
changes.summary: For perspective on the tensions between President Trump and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, Amna Nawaz spoke with former U.S. Ambassador to Ukraine William Taylor. He's now a distinguished fellow at the Atlantic Council.

changes.title: White Sands footprints suggest humans experienced abrupt environmental shifts during the last ice age
changes.summary: Expanded excavations at White Sands National Park in New Mexico have provided researchers an opportunity to refine the age of the oldest human footprints in North America and establish a deeper understanding of the landscape and environmental conditions at the time humans were present there.

changes.title: How U.S. Support to Ukraine Has Evolved Under Trump
changes.summary: President Trump’s latest push to end the war in Ukraine has raised questions about the future of U.S. support.

changes.title: Growing plane and ship traffic degrade the air of western North America
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03239-0 Pollution from transport across the Pacific Ocean is raising ozone levels above a region whose own emissions have dropped.

changes.title: DOJ tells California to review whether noncitizens got mail ballots
changes.summary: The Justice Department has ordered California to review a list of people who the federal government believes may have received mail-in ballots for the upcoming election despite not being U.S. citizens.

changes.title: Can a Radioactive Ore Break China’s Grip on Rare Earths?
changes.summary: The global campaigns to break China’s dominance of vital rare-earth markets are shaping up into one of the signature geostrategic struggles of the early 21st century.
